title: I asked AI to count the R's in strawberry 🍓

beats.say: I asked AI how many R's are in strawberry.
Sorry for the confusion! It's still two.

beats.sub: s - t - r - a - w - b - e - r - r - y
beats.say: There are three. S, T, R, A, W, B, E, R, R, Y.

beats.sub: AI reads chunks called tokens, not letters
beats.say: The reason? AI doesn't see letters. It sees chunks called tokens, like straw, and berry.

beats.sub: big chatbots got this wrong in 2024
beats.say: So it never really saw the R's. In 2024, top chatbots kept answering two.
Follow for more things the algorithm did.
